name: note_empty
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached single gold eighth-note icon into its EMPTY progress-slot state. Keep the EXACT same note outline, silhouette, stroke widths, canvas size, position and geometry; change ONLY material and color. Replace glossy gold with subdued matte soft brown-grey, using a dim brown-grey outline and a quiet slightly lighter neutral brown-grey interior. No bright specular highlights. Overall visual strength should feel about 40 percent opacity on a cream UI pill. Keep it easily recognizable as the same single eighth note, not a new symbol. Actual transparent background, no box, no new border, no cast shadow or haze, no additional elements. Do not move, resize, rotate or redraw the shape.
